neighbours.label: The comma right after a stock linking or comment opener at the start of a sentence ('However,' 'Of course,' 'Honestly,' 'In my opinion,' 'Yes,' 'Oh,'), whatever the opener's length. Quiet: commas after scene-setting phrases ('In the kitchen,' 'Tired and hungry,'), after full clauses ('Because the bus was late,'), after names, and list commas. A weaker side trigger is the space typed before a number.
neighbours.short: comma after a stock linking/comment opener
fire: However, the museum stays open late on Fridays.
Of course, nobody remembered to bring the tent poles.
Honestly, I thought the sequel was better than the original.
In my opinion, the garden looks best in early autumn.
Yes, the package arrived this morning.
Oh, I forgot to water the plants again.
Moreover, the new bridge cuts the commute in half.
Frankly, the instructions made no sense at all.
quiet: In the lobby, the museum keeps a small gift shop.
Because the store was closed, nobody brought the tent poles.
Tired and sleepy, I watched the sequel on the couch.
In the backyard, the garden looks best in early autumn.
Maria, the package arrived this morning.
After the long trip, I forgot to water the plants again.
Across the river, the new bridge shortens the commute.
We bought flour, sugar, eggs and butter for the cake.

predictions: most fire items 0.3-0.6; near misses mostly below 0.15, names possibly ~0.13
